data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'khalaasah', which means 'to be pure' or 'to make pure'. In Islamic context, Khaleesah represents the mother who nurtures and raises her children with virtues and moral values. The name Khaleesah carries the meaning “Mother of Virtuous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaleesah usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
